items.label: Allergy Served Peanuts
items.text: I saw this happen: The restaurant served my meal with peanuts after I noted my allergy.

items.label: Dentist Explained Steps
items.moduleLabel: Care teams offering calm, attentive updates
items.text: I saw this happen: My dentist explained each step before starting the procedure.

items.label: Nurse Night Check
items.moduleLabel: Care teams offering calm, attentive updates
items.text: I saw this happen: The nurse checked in twice during the night to make sure my dad was comfortable.

items.label: Daycare No Call
items.moduleLabel: Care teams that miss critical updates
items.text: I heard this: The daycare forgot to call when my child had a fever.

items.label: Doctor Checked Clock
items.text: I saw this happen: My doctor glanced at the clock twice while I was describing my symptoms today.

items.label: Trainer Celebrated Progress
items.text: I saw this happen: At the 8 a.m. session, the gym trainer high-fived me right after I racked 185 pounds on squats.

items.label: City Fixed Streetlight
items.text: I saw this happen: The city finally fixed the streetlight after months of emails.

items.label: Colleague Took Credit
items.moduleLabel: Credit given to the wrong person
items.text: I saw this happen: My colleague took credit for my idea during the pitch meeting.

items.label: Delivery Marked Delivered
items.moduleLabel: Deliveries marked complete with nothing there
items.text: I saw this happen: At 7 p.m. the delivery app marked my order as delivered while the porch camera still showed an empty doorstep.

items.label: Partner Phone During Dinner
items.text: I saw this happen: My partner scrolled through their phone during dinner instead of looking up.

items.label: Dismissive Eye Roll
items.text: I heard this: At today's 9 a.m. budget review in conference room B, my manager rolled his eyes right after I asked for the spreadsheet update.

items.label: Dismissive Too Sensitive
items.text: I heard this: At dinner tonight at Sam's Diner, a friend said "You're too sensitive" when I declined the joke.

items.label: Dismissive Whatever Door
items.text: I heard this: My teenager muttered "whatever" and slammed the bedroom door after I asked about homework tonight.

items.label: Dismissive Whisper Laugh
items.text: I heard this: During Tuesday's 2 p.m. planning stand-up, my colleague whispered to Taylor and they both laughed right after I described the roadmap change.

items.label: Neighbor Dog Morning
items.text: I saw this happen: My neighbor's dog barked loudly for 30 minutes starting at 6 a.m. on Saturday.

items.label: Contract Not Renewed
items.text: I heard this: The email from HR said my contract wasn't renewed with no explanation.

items.label: Reached Over Last Item
items.moduleLabel: Fairness in lines and shared resources
items.text: I saw this happen: At the grocery store, another shopper reached over me to grab the last carton of eggs.

items.label: Service Line Skip
items.moduleLabel: Fairness in lines and shared resources
items.text: I saw this happen: The barista skipped me and served two people who arrived later in line this afternoon.

items.label: Review No Examples
items.text: I saw this happen: I received a performance review that only listed mistakes without any concrete examples.

items.label: Teacher Derogatory Feedback
items.text: I heard this: The teacher handed back my child's assignment with "sloppy" written across the top.

items.label: Friend Late No Text
items.text: I saw this happen: My friend arrived 30 minutes late to lunch without texting.

items.label: Manager Balanced Followups
items.moduleLabel: Loved ones and leads sharing the load
items.text: I saw this happen: During Monday's sprint review, the project manager assigned two follow-up tasks to each teammate.

items.label: Partner Covered Dinner
items.moduleLabel: Loved ones and leads sharing the load
items.text: I saw this happen: My partner cooked dinner and cleaned the kitchen while I finished my deadline.

items.label: Contractor No Show
items.text: I heard this: The contractor missed today's 8 a.m. appointment and hasn't texted or called.

items.label: Landlord No Response
items.text: I saw this happen: The landlord hasn't responded to three messages about the leak this week.

items.label: Meeting Over Lunch
items.text: I saw this happen: My manager scheduled a meeting over my lunch break without asking.

items.label: Referee Missed Fouls
items.text: I saw this happen: During last night's game, the referee missed three fouls against our team.

items.label: Neighbor Shoveled Sidewalk
items.text: I saw this happen: My neighbor shoveled our sidewalk after the snowstorm while we were at work.

items.label: Driver Speakerphone Entire Trip
items.text: I saw this happen: The rideshare driver talked loudly on speakerphone for the entire trip yesterday.

items.label: Self Delayed Call
items.text: I heard this: I caught myself scrolling for an hour instead of calling my grandmother back.

items.label: Vacation Approved Quickly
items.text: I saw this happen: My boss approved my vacation request the same day I submitted it.

items.label: Counselor Reflected
items.text: I heard this: During therapy, my counselor paused and reflected back exactly what I said before offering input.

items.label: Landlord Fixed Quickly
items.text: I heard this: Our landlord repaired the leaky faucet the day after we reported it.

items.label: Borrowed Car Empty
items.text: I saw this happen: My sibling borrowed my car without asking and returned it with the tank empty.

items.label: Roommate Dishes Repeated
items.text: I saw this happen: My roommate left dirty dishes piled in the sink again before leaving for work.

items.label: Appreciation Specific Note
items.text: I heard this: At 4 p.m., the coordinator emailed me listing the volunteer shifts I covered during the fundraiser.

items.label: Wallet Returned Intact
items.text: I saw this happen: Outside the market at 3 p.m., a stranger handed back my wallet with the cash still inside the billfold.

items.label: Support Agent Followed Up
items.text: I heard this: Yesterday the service agent stayed on the call for each troubleshooting step and emailed this morning to confirm the fix.

items.label: Teammate Sprint Update Gap
items.text: I saw this happen: From Monday through Friday, no cards under my teammate's initials moved on the shared sprint board.

items.label: Coworker Caught Mistake
items.moduleLabel: Teammates catching mistakes before they spread
items.text: I saw this happen: My coworker double-checked the expense report and caught a mistake before we sent it.

items.label: Cyclist Ran Red
items.text: I saw this happen: A cyclist sped through the crosswalk even though the light was red this morning.

items.label: Bus Driver Waited
items.moduleLabel: Transit drivers who wait for you
items.text: I saw this happen: The bus driver waited for me when I was running toward the stop.

items.label: Hoa Lawn Warning
items.text: I saw this happen: Our HOA sent a warning letter about lawn length without asking first.

items.label: Presentation Walkout
items.text: I saw this happen: A coworker slammed her notebook shut and walked out during my presentation yesterday.

items.label: Accused Never Listen
items.text: I heard this: Yesterday evening in the kitchen, my partner said "You never listen" when we talked about chores.

items.label: Client Talked Over
items.text: I heard this: During this morning's 10 a.m. project video call, the client's audio overlapped mine three times when I proposed a change.

items.label: Sibling Did Not Pay
items.text: I saw this happen: My sibling promised to pay me back Friday but still hasn't sent anything.

items.label: Assigned All Followups
items.text: I saw this happen: In last Thursday's sprint retrospective, the project lead assigned me every follow-up action item again.

items.label: Boss Late Night Pings
items.text: I saw this happen: My boss sent me three Slack messages between 11 p.m. and midnight about tomorrow's report.
